name: Firmware Extraction & Analysis
description: Extraction of firmware from embedded devices via hardware and software methods (SPI/I2C flash reading, JTAG/SWD memory dumps, bootloader extraction, OTA capture) followed by binary analysis including filesystem unpacking, string analysis, and reverse engineering of embedded application logic.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to firmware extraction or embedded binary analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands firmware storage architectures and common extraction vectors
evidence: Can explain the difference between NOR flash, NAND flash, and eMMC storage
Understands firmware image structure (bootloader, kernel, filesystem, configuration)
Familiar with common firmware extraction tools (binwalk, flashrom)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Extracts firmware from common targets using documented procedures under supervision
evidence: Successfully reads SPI flash contents using a flash programmer under guidance
Unpacks firmware images using binwalk and identifies filesystem contents
Extracts firmware via UART bootloader console with documented steps
Work reviewed by authorized hardware analyst

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently extracts and analyzes firmware across diverse embedded platforms
evidence: Extracts firmware from targets using multiple methods (flash read, JTAG dump, bootloader exploit) without assistance
Identifies and extracts encrypted or obfuscated firmware sections
Produces complete firmware analysis reports with identified attack surfaces
Successfully analyzed firmware in 3+ distinct engagement types (IoT, automotive, industrial)

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex extraction scenarios including protected and encrypted targets; mentors others
evidence: Bypasses firmware readout protections (RDP, CRP, JTAG locks) to extract firmware
Decrypts vendor-encrypted firmware update packages
Develops custom extraction scripts and tooling for the lab
Reviews firmware analysis work products of junior analysts
Documents new extraction techniques for internal knowledge base

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on firmware security; develops methodology; publishes research
evidence: Develops novel firmware extraction techniques for previously undocumented platforms
Published research or CVEs related to firmware security vulnerabilities
Defines the lab's firmware analysis methodology and training curriculum
Provides expert consultation on firmware security architecture to product teams

assessment_methods.description: Extract firmware from a prepared target device using at least two different methods and produce a complete analysis report
Review firmware analysis reports from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy
Present an unknown embedded device and assess the analyst's approach to identifying and executing firmware extraction

equipment: SPI/I2C flash programmer (e.g., FlashcatUSB, Dediprog SF600)
